title: Show coordinator worker connect URL
summary: Expose backend-owned coordinator connectivity evidence and display the worker coordinator URL on the Network page.
reason: Coordinator mode was showing the bind endpoint such as 0.0.0.0:7830 as the visible coordinator target, which is not the URL workers should use.
behavior_before: Coordinator Network UI could show the bind endpoint as the coordinator target, making 0.0.0.0:7830 look like a usable worker URL.
behavior_after: GET /api/network/workers includes read-only coordinator_connectivity evidence with worker_coordinator_url, bind endpoint, candidate URLs, warnings, and summary lines; the Network page displays Worker Coordinator URL as the headline value while retaining bind endpoint evidence.
manual_validation: Select-String on server page-network.html and facade.py confirmed Worker Coordinator URL label and desktop_network_coordinator_connectivity.v1 schema
rollback_plan: Revert the coordinator_connectivity DTO/facade additions and the Network page label/helper changes; the page will fall back to its previous bind endpoint display.
